title: FrameTrail hypervideo bundle
description: One hypervideo with everything it needs, as one JSON document: the unit of export and import, independent of the _data folder layout. Media files are referenced by URL or relative path, never embedded.

id.description: Id of the hypervideo where it came from. Importers assign a new one.

hypervideo.description: The hypervideo, as in hypervideo.json. Its globalEvents, customCSS and code snippets are code: importers ask before taking them.

annotations.description: All users' annotations of the hypervideo, as in its annotations/ folder.

files.description: The annotation files, keyed by id (the owner's user id at the source).

resources.description: The resource entries the hypervideo uses (its clip, and items made from resources), keyed by id. Omitted inside a project bundle, which carries the whole resources index.

subtitles.description: The subtitle files as WebVTT text, keyed by srclang.
